teaser.en: Brush past a clump of *mzumaa* by the house and the air fills with the clean scent of lemons.
teaser.sw: Ukipita karibu na kichaka cha *mzumaa* kando ya nyumba, hewa hujaa harufu safi ya malimau.

summary.en: *Mzumaa* is lemongrass, an aromatic tufted grass kept in clumps around homesteads. Its leaves make a fragrant tea and are used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mzumaa* ni mchaichai, nyasi yenye harufu nzuri inayoota kwa vichaka, inayopandwa kuzunguka makazi. Majani yake hutengeneza chai yenye harufu nzuri na hutumika kama dawa.

about.en: *Mzumaa* grows as a dense clump of long, narrow, blue-green leaves that arch over at the tips, with thick, pale stalks at the base. Crush or cut a leaf and it gives off a strong lemon scent. It rarely flowers in gardens.
about.sw: *Mzumaa* huota kama kichaka kizito cha majani marefu, membamba, ya kijani-buluu yanayopinda kwenye ncha zake, yenye mashina manene ya rangi hafifu chini. Ukiponda au kukata jani, hutoa harufu kali ya limau. Bustanini ni nadra kutoa maua.

where.en: It is grown in clumps around homesteads, usually close to the kitchen.
where.sw: Hupandwa kwa vichaka kuzunguka makazi, kwa kawaida karibu na jiko.

uses.en: The leaves are made into tea and used in medicine.
uses.sw: Majani yake hutengenezwa chai na hutumika kama dawa.

names.en: The Digo name is *mzumaa*. Swahili calls it *mchaichai*. In English it is lemongrass.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mzumaa*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mchaichai*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *lemongrass*.

reason.en: Another homestead plant for tea and medicine
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa nyumbani kwa chai na dawa
Mmea mwingine wa nyumbani wenye harufu nzuri
Mmea mwingine wa dawa wenye harufu nzuri

reason.en: A wild relative in the grass family
reason.sw: Jamaa wa porini katika familia ya nyasi
